title: how I calmed down my period (part 1)

segments.text: It's day 43 of me tracking my female hormones and something wild happened. So, here are my hormones normally and here are my hormones for the last cycle. My daily hormones seem to calmer. My estrogen swung 35% less, my progesterone swung 30% less, and my cycle length shortened. [music] So, what's going on?

First, my cycles have never been regular. Over the last 18 months, they've ranged from 31 to 68 days. [music] And the hormones underneath have always been noisy. I would regularly max out my test. I would have these big spikes in my data and I would have multiple waves per cycle. But then I changed my lifestyle overnight dramatically. I did 40 days of perfect consistency. Same food, same workout, same bedtime, no alcohol, 8 and 1/2 hours of sleep, the same hydration, no cheat days, and no deviations. So, here is how that consistency affected my results. This last cycle, I had a 34-day

long cycle. I had a clean LH surge. My estrogen rose once, my progesterone rose on schedule, and I had a 35% smaller swing in my hormones. And I ovulated around day 24 versus my usual 29. So, all things said, this was my most normal-looking cycle ever. So, why would this happen? Keep in mind, I just started this really intense protocol.
I'm very stressed, I'm very overwhelmed, I'm incorporating a lot of newness into my life, and yet it was the calmest cycle ever. Well, here are a few theories why.
